name: Swift
summary: Multiband satellite primarily for transient astronomy; archived XRT data are used to search the Galactic halo for sterile-neutrino dark-matter lines.
detection_principle: XRT imaging spectra stack many observations and remove point sources to search for narrow lines at 3–6 keV; BAT supplies hard-X-ray coverage.

status.label: Current operational status not fully verified
status.evidence: This dark-matter dossier focuses on a 2022 archive analysis, which alone does not establish 2026 operation.

collaboration.name: Swift collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Institutional participation refers to the period covered by each source; this dossier does not claim to provide a complete membership list.

key_parameters.name: Representative analysis exposure
key_parameters.value: About 77 Ms over the full field; about 41 Ms after point-source removal

results.summary: No significant line was found, including near 3.5 keV, yielding dark-matter parameter constraints.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
